content.text: Almost. Health Canada says solids start around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months, so he's about a month out. Until then, breast milk or formula is still all he needs. Around 6 months, look for signs he's ready: sitting with support, good head control, and reaching for your food. A good first food is iron-rich, like iron-fortified infant cereal, mashed meat, or lentils. Confirm the timing with your provider or public health.
